_note: DEVELOPMENT STUB — not any deployment's registry. Production mounts its own file over this one via MODEL_CONFIG in docker/.env (see docker/_env and the README). Do NOT edit this file in place on a server: it is tracked by git, so a checkout/reset/stash/pull would silently revert the live registry to this stub and the service would fail to start on the next restart, taking down every install that shares it. app/main.py ignores keys other than 'models'. Weight paths are written as ${MODEL_BASE}/... and resolved at startup by app/utils/config_loader.py; MODEL_BASE defaults to /datasets, so a config that sets nothing resolves exactly as it always has. A registry mounted over this one must keep the ${MODEL_BASE} prefix to be relocatable.
